name: Tamsin Furrowfield
title: Farmer
examine: A seed ledger under one arm and three schemes for next season behind her eyes.
lines: The hens lay for me because I ask nicely and carry grain. Mostly the grain.
Cotton, next year. Jorel says the soil's wrong. The soil and I have already agreed; we're letting him catch up.
A croft burns in a night. A town takes longer. That's the whole of why we're here.
